name: @ts-capture/core
description: ts-capture core — capture runtime values, shape them as TypeScript types. Engine + CLI for instrumentation, observation, and apply. (0.x — API may change between minor versions.)

scripts.build: node ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.cjs --packages=external && esbuild src/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/preload.cjs --packages=external && esbuild src/setup.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/setup.cjs --packages=external
scripts.pretest: node ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.cjs --packages=external && esbuild src/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/preload.cjs --packages=external && esbuild src/setup.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/setup.cjs --packages=external
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test

author: Sverre Ølnes <sverre.olnes@gmail.com>
